name: agent-crash-test
description: Run a model that says yes to everything against an agentic website, on its own page, and see which actions run without asking the visitor.
author: Mohammed Abadi

scripts.build: npm run generate && node tools/scripts/build_network.mjs site/agent_crash_test.hocon --manifest site/agent-manifest.json && node tools/scripts/build_network.mjs site/shops/corner-weak/corner_shop_weak.hocon --manifest site/shops/corner-weak/agent-manifest.json && node tools/scripts/build_network.mjs site/shops/corner-fixed/corner_shop_fixed.hocon --manifest site/shops/corner-fixed/agent-manifest.json
